title: Merchant
summary: MER'CHANT, noun [Latin mercor, to buy.] 1. A man who trafficks or carries on trade with foreign countries, or who exports and imports goods and sells them by wholesale. 2. In popular usage, any trader

inlines.v: MER'CHANT, noun [Latin mercor, to buy.] 1. A man who trafficks or carries on trade with foreign countries, or who exports and imports goods and sells them by wholesale. 2. In popular usage, any trader, or one who deals in the purchase and sale of goods. 3. A ship in trade. [Not used.] MER'CHANT, verb intransitive To trade. [Not in use.]
